sentences.content: Tom, can you tell me a story from Europe?
sentences.english: Tom , can you tell me a story from Europe ?
sentences.chinese: Tom，你能给我讲一个欧洲的故事吗？

sentences.content: Well, I know one. It’s called The Emperor’s New Clothes.
sentences.english: Well , I know one . It's called The Emperor's New Clothes
sentences.chinese: 嗯，我知道一个，叫做《皇帝的新装》。

sentences.content: This story is about an emperor who loved clothes.
sentences.english: This story is about an emperor who loved clothes
sentences.chinese: 这个故事讲的是一位爱穿新衣的皇帝。

sentences.content: He loved buying and looking at his beautiful clothes.

sentences.content: So what happened?
sentences.english: So what happened ?

sentences.content: Two brothers came to the city to make special clothes for the emperor.
sentences.english: Two brothers came to the city to make special clothes for the emperor
sentences.chinese: 两兄弟来到城里为皇帝制作特殊的衣服。

sentences.content: But the emperor had to give them silk and gold.
sentences.english: But the emperor had to give them silk and gold
sentences.chinese: 但皇帝不得不赐予他们丝绸和黄金。

sentences.content: Oh, so they were really trying to cheat the emperor!

sentences.content: How can you save us?

sentences.chinese: 你怎能救得了我们？

sentences.content: Be quiet! I’m going outside to get something in the moonlight. Now, go to sleep.
sentences.english: Be quiet ! I'm going outside to get something in the moonlight . Now , go to sleep
sentences.chinese: 安静！我要趁着月光出去拿点东西。现在，去睡觉吧。

sentences.chinese: 是的，亲爱的们。你们得跟我一起去森林里拾柴火。

sentences.content: Here’s some bread. Don’t eat it until you get to the forest.
sentences.english: Here's some bread . Don't eat it until you get to the forest
sentences.chinese: 这里有些面包。到了森林再吃。

sentences.content: Hansel, what are you doing?

sentences.chinese: Hansel，你在做什么？

sentences.content: I’m dropping white stones along the way.
sentences.english: I'm dropping white stones along the way
sentences.chinese: 我正沿途撒下白色的石头。

sentences.content: Unless I do, we’ll be lost.
sentences.english: Unless I do , we'll be lost
sentences.chinese: 除非我这么做，否则我们会迷失方向。

sentences.content: Tonight, when the moon is shining bright, we’ll be able to see the stones.
sentences.english: Tonight , when the moon is shining bright , we'll be able to see the stones

sentences.content: You bad children! What a long time you slept in the forest!

sentences.content: We thought you were never coming back.

sentences.chinese: 我们还以为你再也不会回来了。

sentences.content: Now, go to bed. As soon as you wake up, you must go to the forest with your father.

sentences.content: What, again? I want to go out to look at the moon.

sentences.content: No. You can’t go out now.

sentences.content: What can we do? You have no more stones.

sentences.content: I’ll drop pieces of bread. As soon as the moon rises, we can follow them instead.

sentences.content: I can’t see any bread on the ground. Maybe it was the birds.

sentences.content: Never mind! Just keep walking.
sentences.english: Never mind ! Just keep walking

sentences.content: Unless we do, we won’t find our way out.

sentences.content: Hansel, we’re really lost!
sentences.english: Hansel , we're really lost !
sentences.chinese: Hansel，我们真的迷路了！

sentences.content: Listen! That bird’s song is so beautiful that we should follow it.

sentences.content: Look! It’s leading us to that wonderful house made of bread, cake and candy.

sentences.chinese: 看！它正把我们引向那座用面包、蛋糕和糖果做成的奇妙房子。

sentences.content: Let’s eat part of the house!
sentences.english: Let's eat part of the house !
sentences.chinese: 让我们吃掉房子的一部分吧！

sentences.content: Who is that? Who is brave enough to eat my house?
sentences.english: Who is that ? Who is brave enough to eat my house ?
sentences.chinese: 那是谁？谁这么大胆敢吃掉我的房子？

statements.chinese: 看！它正带我们走向那座漂亮的房子

statements.english: made of bread , cake and candy
statements.chinese: 由面包、蛋糕和糖果制成的

statements.english: Look ! It's leading us to that wonderful house made of bread , cake and candy
statements.chinese: 看！它正把我们引向那座用面包、蛋糕和糖果做成的奇妙房子

statements.english: Let's eat part of the house !
statements.chinese: 让我们吃掉房子的一部分吧！

statements.english: Who is brave enough to eat my house ?
statements.chinese: 谁有胆量吃掉我的房子？

statements.english: Who is that ? Who is brave enough to eat my house ?
statements.chinese: 那是谁？谁这么大胆敢吃掉我的房子？
